description: Implement graceful fallback behavior for the lingo.dev i18n automation when the required API key is not configured. The system should skip the GitHub workflow entirely and return safe defaults from the service layer with appropriate warnings, rather than attempting to run and failing.
functional_requirements: Add a conditional check in the GitHub i18n workflow to skip execution when the CI_LINGO_DOT_DEV_API_KEY secret is not available
Modify the LingoDotDevService to conditionally instantiate the engine only when the API key environment variable is present

Update all public service methods (localizeText, batchLocalizeText, localizeTexts) to return safe default values (null, empty array, original texts) with a warning log when the engine is not available
